notes: Help is up to date: new topics for Pages, Master projects, and the Crop tool and Silhouette maker, with a guided tour of the page bar.

Fixed: Pages are now part of every design, not just master projects. The page bar (Page 1 of 1, New page, Copy page) is always above the canvas. With more than one page, Save project keeps all the pages together in one file; a single page saves as before.

New: Master projects now open on a blank canvas. File > New master project: type the client or project name, pick a page size, click Start. It makes the folder (with Consultations, Assets, Live work in progress, Customer communication inside) and opens the job. Existing jobs have an Open button.

New: Pages. Every master project has a bar above the canvas: Save project and Save page on the left, Page 1 of 3 with arrows in the middle, New page on the right (Blank page or Copy page). Copy page and a click on Page 1 of 3 show all your pages in a swipe gallery: the middle page large, the ones either side smaller and see-through.

New: Save project saves every page together in the job's Live work in progress folder; Save page saves just the page you are on as its own file. Open project and Open from saved files bring a whole master project back.

New: Promote Imagination (File menu). Sends a short promo film about the app to anyone as a private link, the same way a client consultation does. Put their name on the start screen, add your WhatsApp and email on the last slide, then send by WhatsApp or email. Close the link when you are done.

The promo ends with a Make an enquiry form (name, email, WhatsApp number, project requirements, preferred contact method; WhatsApp recommended) that opens a ready-written message to you, plus a copyable link to get the app. It has no version numbers, so it never looks out of date.
You can also download the personal promo as one file.

New: Crop tool (C). Draw round part of a picture, shape or text, freehand or with any shape from the same shape menu as the draw tools. The piece you cut out and the part left behind both stay on screen as their own pictures, each with a hit box that follows its shape.
New: Smart edge in the Crop tool. Loop loosely round a subject and the cut snaps to its real edge.

New: Silhouette maker (left toolbar). Select a picture and see it in nine silhouette styles on your own photo (solid subject, hard contrast, soft cut-paper, stencil, three and four tones, line art, halftone dots, scan lines), then choose how dark it goes, the ink and paper colours, or invert.
A folder you add to a master project can be copied into every master project.
The colour box has an eyedropper again to pick a colour from anywhere on screen.
